videos.title: Christmas in the Air
videos.description: A no-nonsense professional organizer (Catherine Bell) learns that opposites do attract when she begins to fall for her client, a frazzled widower (Eric Close) who spends his time inventing toys.

videos.title: Deck the Halls on Cherry Lane
videos.description: Three generations of neighbors on Cherry Lane experience life-changing Christmases, from a mistaken address leading to a live TV special, to a family facing their last holiday together, to best friends discovering unexpected love.

videos.title: Where Are You, Christmas?
videos.description: Addy wishes for a year without Christmas and wakes up in a black-and-white world. She must work together with the town mechanic to restore the holiday to all its glory.

videos.title: Christmas Bedtime Stories
videos.description: When Danielle's husband goes missing in action during his deployment, she's left to raise her daughter on her own. Three years later, as she acclimates to life without him, she begins to tell her daughter bedtime stories about her father.

videos.title: Karen Kingsbury's Maggie's Christmas Miracle
videos.description: Maggie tries to maintain the balance of being a mother and having a career. When her son Jordan needs help at school, he meets Casey, a tutor, and the two quickly bond. As Casey becomes a father figure, Jordan wishes his mom could find love again.

videos.title: Crashing Through the Snow
videos.description: Maggie and Sam are crashing Christmas. When he proposes that they team up against his sister's perfect Christmas, neither of them are prepared for the blended family challenges that lie ahead.

videos.title: The Christmas Promise
videos.description: Nicole learns to deal with grief, with the help of her grandfather and a carpenter she hires to renovate the home that was once meant for her and her fiancé.

videos.title: Christmas in Tahoe
videos.description: To save her family's hotel Christmas show, a talent booker must ask for help from her ex-boyfriend -- the lead guitarist of a now-famous band that fired her as its manager years ago.

videos.title: Christmas Homecoming
videos.description: A military widow whose faith in Christmas has lapsed rents an apartment to a soldier who is recovering from an injury in battle. When they team up to save the town's military museum, these two wounded birds find themselves falling in love.

videos.title: A Christmas Together With You
videos.description: Planning on spending the holidays alone, Megan and her father figure, Frank, go on a road trip to find his first true love.

videos.title: Once Upon a Christmas Miracle
videos.description: Told she would have less than a few months to live without a new liver, Heather's time was running out when a kind stranger heard of her plight and discovered he was a perfect match. The two met and before long a friendship developed into romance.

videos.title: Christmas She Wrote
videos.description: When a writer has her column canceled right before Christmas, she heads home to reconnect with her family, only to receive an unexpected visit from the man who canceled her column.

videos.title: This Time Each Year
videos.description: Despite a trial separation, Lauren pretends to still be with her husband, Kevin, to placate her overbearing mother. The ruse may be just what the couple needs to finally work on their marriage.

videos.title: A Kismet Christmas
videos.description: A children's author reconnects with her hometown, family and teenage crush while confronting a legend that may actually be true.

videos.title: Looks Like Christmas
videos.description: An over-involved single mother (Anne Heche) butts heads with a single dad (Dylan Neal) over the school's annual Christmas Spectacular, an event that she feels like she owns.

videos.title: A Fabled Holiday
videos.description: Talia and her childhood best friend unexpectedly reunite in a curiously familiar-looking town that's full of Christmas spirit.

videos.title: Rescuing Christmas
videos.description: Erin unwittingly wishes away Christmas, and Sam steps in to help bring it back.

videos.title: Debbie Macomber's Trading Christmas
videos.description: Holiday travel leads to cross-country romances when a man (Tom Cavanagh) and a woman (Faith Ford) temporarily swap houses.

videos.title: Debbie Macomber's Dashing Through the Snow
videos.description: A young woman becomes stranded in an airport at Christmastime and accepts a ride from a man who rented the last rental car in town. As they head north, a hint of romance develops when they encounter a few bumps on the road.

videos.title: Debbie Macomber's A Mrs. Miracle Christmas
videos.description: When members of a family face loneliness and lose faith, Mrs. Miracle swoops in to renew their Christmas spirit.

videos.title: Debbie Macomber's Joyful Mrs. Miracle
videos.description: Mrs. Miracle uses Christmas magic to reunite three siblings who must decide who will inherit the family's real estate empire, following their grandmother's passing.

videos.title: Two Turtle Doves
videos.description: Dr. Sharon Hayes returns home to search for a beloved family heirloom. With the help of an adorable little girl and her dispirited father, together they rediscover the magic of Christmas.

videos.title: 'Tis the Season to Be Irish
videos.description: Rose tries to flip a house in Ireland but is blocked by Sean, a handsome local who wants to preserve the historic cottage.

videos.title: It's Christmas, Eve
videos.description: A school superintendent with a knack for turning around schools meets a single father who works as the head of the school's bankrupt music department. As she rediscovers her passion for music, she works to save the dreams of the kids who love music.

videos.title: Sealed With a List
videos.description: This holiday season, festive Carley sets out to conquer her list of abandoned resolutions from last year. Aided by co-worker Wyatt, she finds love and the confidence to chase her dreams.

videos.title: A Homecoming for the Holidays
videos.description: Country singer Charlotte is home for the holidays and works with her brother's friend to build a house for a friend in town.

videos.title: I'm Not Ready for Christmas
videos.description: Holly's world is turned upside down when her niece's wish to Santa Claus comes true, and she cannot tell a lie. As her career and love life go into disarray, she must learn to judge between the truth and what is right.

videos.title: #Xmas
videos.description: When interior designer Jen is selected for a social media competition for a design brand, she poses as an influencer with her best friend playing her husband and her nephew as her baby.

videos.title: My Christmas Guide
videos.description: After losing his eyesight, a college professor adopts a seeing-eye dog from a guide dog trainer. As they all spend time together, his confidence returns and his heart begins to open.

videos.title: A Joyous Christmas
videos.description: A successful motivational speaker learns the true meaning of Christmas when a stranger rescues her from a near-fatal accident.

videos.title: Silver Bells
videos.description: A teenage runaway (Michael Mitchell) connects his widowed father (Tate Donovan) and a woman (Anne Heche) who lost her husband during a past Christmas holiday.

videos.title: Magic Stocking
videos.description: Lindsey, a widowed single mother, stays closed off to life after losing her husband. When she buys a stocking at a craft fair, her family members begin finding items in it that have importance in their lives.

videos.title: Angel Falls: A Novel Holiday
videos.description: Book editor Hannah must work with former rival Ryan to help a potential writer find her way, and Angel Anthony reminds them about Christmas spirit and the value of community.

videos.title: Christmas at Dollywood
videos.description: When a NYC event planner returns to Tennessee to organize the Christmas celebration at Dollywood, she's paired with the head of operations who thinks he can handle the party just fine on his own.

videos.title: Christmas at Pemberley Manor
videos.description: A rich man falls back in love with Christmas and a party planner.

videos.title: Chateau Christmas
videos.description: A world-renowned pianist rediscovers her passion for music after reuniting with her ex during the holidays.

videos.title: Gingerbread Miracle
videos.description: A man and an old high school friend try to sell his uncle's business -- a Mexican bakery that's famous for magical gingerbread cookies that grant wishes.
